newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Astra Argentina cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Astra Argentina cut.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said analysts Jose Costa Buck and Gonzalo Pangaro had cut their rating for Argentine oil firm Astra Cia Argentina de Petroleo SA to hold from buy.

-- "Astra's hefty cash flow generation, rising oil production, compelling valuation ratios, high level of proven reserves and the potential efficiencies from Repsol (SA) management ... make Astra an attractive vehicle with which to play Argentina's energy sector," they wrote in a March 12 report.

-- However, they warned that Astra could be sizing up new purchases. "We suggest that investors hold their positions until Repsol proves its ability to create value for minority shareholders, at least in the near term."
-- Shares in the company closed on Wednesday at 1.61 pesos in Buenos Aires.
